title: FAB: Fast and Demand-Aware Bandwidth Allocation Method for Wavelength-Routed Optical Networks-on-Chip
problem: Wavelength-routed optical NoCs require optimization of bandwidth allocation via core-to-port mapping and microring resonator radii configuration; existing methods are slow and achieve poor quality solutions for large applications.
motivation: Optical interconnects offer high bandwidth and low power for on-chip communication; requires efficient optimization methods.
method: Graph-based approach formulating core-to-port mapping and MRR radii configuration as two-stage weighted subgraph matching with strict weight-based strategies and progressive relaxation for infeasible cases.
key_novelty: Novel two-stage graph-based approach for fast demand-aware bandwidth allocation in WRONoC.
contributions: Graph-based formulation for WRONoC bandwidth allocation
Weight-based matching strategies with progressive relaxation
87.5% latency reduction with 500,000x speedup vs SOTA

metrics.other: Achieves high-quality solutions for large applications

limitations: WRONoC-specific; doesn't optimize for other metrics (power, area); evaluation on unspecified applications.
